sources.title: Introducing the most grounded language model in the world - Contextual AI
sources.snippet: Today, we're introducing our Grounded Language Model (GLM), the most grounded language model in the world. With state-of-the-art performance on FACTS (the leading groundedness benchmark) and our customer datasets, the GLM is the single best language model for RAG and agentic use cases for which minimizing hallucinations is critical.
